primary_source_policy: Read complete cached JATS or original full text and required supplements. Check corrections, disputes, licenses and final media independently before release.

candidates.idea: A crow can raise a floating reward by choosing what to drop into water
candidates.abstract_support: Experiment reports preferences for water over sand, sinking over floating and solid over hollow objects
candidates.critical_limit: The birds failed two harder tasks; avoid claims of complete causal understanding or human-equivalent intelligence
candidates.state: await full-text, correction, supplementary and visual-rights review

candidates.idea: Retinal movements in a resting spider point toward an REM-like state
candidates.abstract_support: Authors report recurring retinal movements during sleep-like inactivity
candidates.critical_limit: REM-like does not prove dreams or mammalian REM; interpret behavior cautiously
candidates.state: await full-text, correction, supplementary and visual-rights review

candidates.idea: Cigarette filters in nests are associated with fewer ectoparasites
candidates.abstract_support: Nest-material association and a separate heat-trap comparison
candidates.critical_limit: Does not prove birds deliberately medicate themselves or improve fitness; avoid encouraging litter or claiming nicotine is harmless
candidates.state: await full-text, correction, supplementary and visual-rights review

candidates.idea: Octopuses cycle between quiet and active sleep-like states
candidates.abstract_support: Four adult Octopus insularis were observed with behavioral state measurements
candidates.critical_limit: Small group, behavioral definition, and no demonstration that octopuses dream
candidates.state: await full-text, supplementary, corrections and visual-rights review

candidates.idea: A reef fish changes behavior toward a mirror and visible marks
candidates.abstract_support: Fish displayed mark-test behaviors under particular conditions
candidates.critical_limit: Mirror-test interpretation is contested; not direct proof of consciousness/self-awareness
candidates.state: await full-text, follow-up and competing-explanation review

candidates.idea: Groups of ants interlock and float in a waterproof raft
candidates.abstract_support: Time-lapse experiments examined raft assembly and hydrophobicity
candidates.critical_limit: Do not claim individual ants float effortlessly or consciously coordinate every movement; current episode TT-009 already features ants
candidates.state: await full-text, rights and correction review

candidates.idea: Sickness-like immune challenge alters group contact
candidates.abstract_support: Authors report reduced social contacts following immunological challenge
candidates.critical_limit: Immune challenge is not an infection, reduced encounters do not establish deliberate altruistic distancing
candidates.state: await full-text, rights and correction review
